zh-CN.content.blog.firstCloud.title: 第一次上云，该怎么选服务器
zh-CN.content.blog.firstCloud.excerpt: CPU、内存、带宽、线路……按业务规模挑，不花一分冤枉钱。
zh-CN.content.blog.firstCloud.body: 选型是上云的第一步。轻型网站、开发测试，2核4G 就能流畅起步；业务增长后平滑升配，按月按年灵活结算。把需求讲清楚，我们帮你评估用量，不为用不上的资源付费。
zh-CN.content.blog.nightSky.title: 稳定，是设计出来的
zh-CN.content.blog.nightSky.excerpt: 从架构到运维，每一步都为「可预期」服务。
zh-CN.content.blog.nightSky.body: 真实经营、资质齐备、架构自持，这三件事我们从第一天起就做到了。选择我们，就是选择一个看得清、查得到、靠得住的云。
zh-CN.content.testimonials.1.quote: 资质、价格、响应，三样都让人放心。业务放这里，很少需要操心。
zh-CN.content.testimonials.1.name: 李强
zh-CN.content.testimonials.2.quote: 从选配置到上线，全程有人跟，快到超出预期。
zh-CN.content.testimonials.2.name: 周敏
zh-CN.content.testimonials.3.quote: 想升配就升配，想换线路就换线路，没有被绑死的感觉。
zh-CN.content.testimonials.3.name: 陈浩

en-US.content.hero.heroTitle: Find your own cloud in deep space
en-US.content.hero.heroSubtitle: A steady light in the dark. Real operations, complete credentials and independent architecture — reliability is the default from your first server.
en-US.content.why.whyText: The certainty the cloud should provide, delivered in one go.
en-US.content.why.feature1Text: Legally registered with real operations, verifiable from the very first conversation.
en-US.content.why.feature2Text: Filing and service licenses are in place; compliance is the baseline, not a bonus.
en-US.content.why.feature3Text: Self-built architecture and owned resources — scale up without gatekeepers, on your own roadmap.
en-US.content.stats.stat1Desc: Our own architecture keeps watch; downtime is not an option.
en-US.content.stats.stat2Desc: Whenever something comes up, you get an answer.
en-US.content.stats.stat3Desc: A registered business; every order is compliant and traceable.
en-US.content.cta.ctaTitle: Getting to the cloud should not be complicated
en-US.content.cta.ctaText: Pick a configuration, deploy, go live — a few steps is all it takes.
en-US.content.blog.firstCloud.title: Choosing your first cloud server
en-US.content.blog.firstCloud.excerpt: CPU, memory, bandwidth, routing… size it to your business and never pay for what you do not use.
en-US.content.blog.firstCloud.body: Sizing is the first step to the cloud. A small site or a dev/test box runs smoothly on 2 cores and 4 GB; as you grow, upgrade smoothly and settle monthly or yearly. Tell us what you need and we will help estimate usage, so you never pay for idle resources.
en-US.content.blog.nightSky.title: Stability is designed
en-US.content.blog.nightSky.excerpt: From architecture to operations, every step serves predictability.
en-US.content.blog.nightSky.body: Real operations, complete credentials and self-owned architecture — we have done all three since day one. Choosing us means choosing a cloud you can see, verify and rely on.
en-US.content.testimonials.1.quote: Credentials, pricing and response times all put us at ease. We rarely have to worry about running our business here.
en-US.content.testimonials.1.name: Li Qiang
en-US.content.testimonials.2.quote: From sizing to launch there was someone with us the whole way, faster than we expected.
en-US.content.testimonials.2.name: Zhou Min
en-US.content.testimonials.3.quote: Upgrade when I want, switch routes when I want — nothing feels locked in.
en-US.content.testimonials.3.name: Chen Hao
